purpose: The list of screenshots for the handbook: per image the keys the program receives and when to photograph.
details: Each function decorated with @scenario(name, ...) receives a Draai object (from schermafdrukken.py) that already stands in the main menu (unless kind=False) and navigates with d.toets/d.wacht and photographs with d.foto(name, title). Keys are tmux key names, ('tekst', text) for typed text and ('klik', row, col) for mouse clicks. The scenario functions are all named `_` (they are only registered, never called by name), so they appear in this map by their line number: the keys are '_@<line of the def>'. Answers are computed from the question text on screen (the fixed random seed LEERAVONTUUR_ZAAD makes questions repeat). Note from CLAUDE.md: these images still show the menus of version 0.19 and are redone in the handbook project. Run via `python3 docs/tools/schermafdrukken.py [prefix]`.
module_docstring: De schermafdrukken van de handleiding: per beeld welke toetsen het programma krijgt.

constants.name: SCENARIOS
constants.explanation: Registry: scenario name -> (function, options). Filled by the decorator at import time.

constants.name: OPNIEUW
constants.explanation: Keys that stop and start free practice again at Normal level to get a new question: Escape, 1, 2.

registries.name: SCENARIOS
registries.description: Maps a screenshot scenario name to (function, options); filled by @scenario when the module is imported and read by schermafdrukken.main, which calls each function with a Draai object.

functions.name: scenario
functions.explanation: Decorator factory: registers the decorated function in SCENARIOS under a name together with its options (argumenten for start arguments, kind=False to start without choosing a child). Returns the decorator.

functions.name: zet
functions.explanation: The decorator itself: stores (function, options) in SCENARIOS and returns the function unchanged.

functions.name: wiskunde
functions.docstring: Hoofdmenu → Leren & oefenen → Wiskunde → domein (→ onderwerp).
functions.explanation: Navigates Hoofdmenu > Leren & oefenen > Wiskunde > domain (and optionally topic) by sending number keys and waiting for each menu title.

functions.name: oefen
functions.docstring: … → onderwerp → vorm (1 vrij, 2 reeks) → niveau (1 makkelijk … 4 heel moeilijk).
functions.explanation: Navigates to a topic and starts it: form (1 free, 2 series) and level (1 easy ... 4 very hard).

functions.name: scherm_tekst
functions.explanation: The current screen as plain text (imports scherm from schermafdrukken).

functions.name: antwoord
functions.docstring: Typ een antwoord en Enter. Was het fout, dan geeft de vaste werkwijze eerst een tweede kans: met tweede_kans=True typt het scenario hetzelfde antwoord nog eens, zodat het beeld nagekeken is (zoals vroeger).
functions.explanation: Types an answer and Enter; if the screen then shows 'Probeer nog eens!' (second chance) types the same answer again so the checked screen appears.
Scenario 'basis-start': Starts without a child (kind=False): photographs the start screen, presses Enter to open the child choice and photographs 'Wie ben jij?'.
Scenario 'basis-hoofdmenu': Photographs the main menu after the child was chosen.
Scenario 'basis-menus': Walks Leren & oefenen > Wiskunde > Hoofdrekenen > first topic > free practice and photographs each menu: subject, domains, topics, form of practice and level.

Scenario 'basis-oefenen': Free practice of the times tables: photographs a question, the tip after F1 ('?'), a correct answer (computed from the question text) and a wrong answer (1) with its explanation.
Scenario 'basis-reeks': A series of 10 in the tables: answers questions 4 and 8 wrongly, the rest rightly, and photographs the first question, the result report and the 'fouten opnieuw' screen.

functions.name: eenheden
functions.explanation: Navigates the unit-conversion menus: form, unit kind and level.
Scenario 'eenheden-menu': Opens the unit-conversion menus and photographs the form choice, the unit-kind choice and the 'choose your own units' tick screen.
Scenario 'eenheden-vrij': Free practice of unit conversion: photographs a question, then computes the answer one column too far (a typical thinking error) and photographs the explanation.

functions.name: vul_tabel
functions.docstring: Leest de tabelvraag van het scherm en vult de tabel juist in: cijfers, komma en antwoord.
functions.explanation: Reads the table question from the screen and fills the unit table correctly: digits cell by cell, the comma after the target unit, and the answer in the box.
Scenario 'eenheden-tabel': The table exercise for length: photographs the empty table, fills it in correctly with vul_tabel, photographs it, checks and photographs the verdict.
Scenario 'eenheden-oppervlakte': The unit table for area (two cells per unit): fills it in and photographs the checked result.
Scenario 'eenheden-volume': The unit table for volume at a harder level: photographs the empty table.
Scenario 'eenheden-spiekbrief': Opens the Eenheden cheat sheet from the menu and photographs it.

functions.name: volgende
functions.docstring: Een (fout) antwoord geven en naar de volgende vraag.
functions.explanation: Gives a (wrong) answer and moves on to the next question.
Scenario 'hoofdrekenen': Mental arithmetic, adding and subtracting: photographs a question and, after a wrong answer, the explanation with a strategy.
Scenario 'hoofdrekenen-splitsen': Splitting strategy: photographs the question with the klad open at once.

Scenario 'werkwijze': Shows the fixed work method: types a rule in the klad (Tab) and photographs it checked, then a wrong answer with a hint and second chance, then a second wrong answer with 'Zo kan het:'.
Scenario 'hoofdrekenen-maal10': Multiplying and dividing by 10, 100, 1000: photographs a question.
Scenario 'hoofdrekenen-dubbel': Doubling and halving: photographs a question.
Scenario 'getallen-plaatswaarde': Place value: photographs a question.
Scenario 'getallen-afronden': Rounding: photographs a question.
Scenario 'getallen-deelbaarheid': Divisibility: photographs a question.
Scenario 'getallen-lijn': Number line, pointing out: photographs a question.
Scenario 'getallen-lijn-zoom': Number line: zooms in with + and photographs the zoomed line.
Scenario 'getallen-lijn-aflezen': Number line / thermometer, reading off at a higher level: photographs a question.

functions.name: rooster_getallen
functions.docstring: De getallen in het rooster (cijfers met een spatie ertussen), van boven naar onder.
functions.explanation: Reads the numbers of the column sum from rows 8-20 of the screen (without operators and spaces).
Scenario 'cijferen-optellen': Column addition: fills in the grid (reading the numbers with rooster_getallen), photographs it and a hint on a cell with F1.
Scenario 'cijferen-vermenigvuldigen': Column multiplication: photographs the grid.
Scenario 'cijferen-staart': Long division: photographs step 1 and the division growing as steps are answered.
Scenario 'breuken-arceren': Fraction bar: photographs the bar, shaded pieces, and the checked verdict.
Scenario 'breuken-vereenvoudigen': Simplifying fractions: photographs a question.
Scenario 'breuken-vergelijken': Comparing fractions: photographs the question and the checked explanation.
Scenario 'breuken-optellen': Adding fractions: photographs a question and the explanation after adding numerators and denominators (bars show why it is wrong).
Scenario 'breuken-van': A fraction of a number: photographs the question and the explanation with groups.
Scenario 'breuken-kommagetal': Fraction and decimal: photographs a question.
Scenario 'procenten-veld': Hundred-square: photographs the square, whole rows coloured with r and single cells with Space, and the checked result.
Scenario 'procenten-omzetten': Percent, fraction, decimal conversion: photographs a question.
Scenario 'procenten-van': Percent of a number with the percentage strip: photographs the question and the explanation when the percentage was given as the answer.
Scenario 'procenten-korting': Discount and VAT at a higher level: photographs a question.
Scenario 'tijd-gemengd': Minutes to hours and minutes: photographs the question and the explanation after counting with 100 instead of 60.
Scenario 'tijd-eindtijd': Arrival time: photographs the question and the checked explanation.
Scenario 'klok-lezen': Reading the analogue clock: photographs a question.
Scenario 'klok-zetten': Setting the clock hands: photographs the clock where the hour hand turns along.
Scenario 'klok-woorden-fout': Clock in words: reads 'half vier' as 'half vijf' and photographs the explanation about 'half'.

functions.docstring: Het klokvenster (tkinter) kan tmux niet fotograferen: het beeld komt uit dezelfde vormen (venster/klokbeeld.py).
functions.explanation: Scenario 'klokvenster': Cannot photograph the tkinter window with tmux: draws two SVG images of the clock window from klokbeeld.vormen/naar_svg (reading, and setting with the correct hands in green) into the handbook images folder.
Scenario 'klok-ascii': Starts with --ascii and photographs the clock in characters (# hour hand, * minute hand).
Scenario 'tijd-geld': Money: photographs a change question and its explanation.
Scenario 'tijd-snelheid': Speed at a higher level: photographs a question.
Scenario 'meetkunde-rooster': Perimeter on the cm² grid: photographs the grid and the checked result with the outline marked.
Scenario 'meetkunde-driehoek': Triangle with half cells: photographs the grid.
Scenario 'meetkunde-formules': Formulas (circle) at a higher level: photographs a question.
Scenario 'meetkunde-hoek': What kind of angle: photographs the question and the checked explanation.
Scenario 'meetkunde-schatkaart': Treasure map: photographs the map question.
Scenario 'meetkunde-kruisje': Placing the cross with arrows or a click: photographs it.
Scenario 'meetkunde-assen': Coordinate system (first year of secondary school): photographs it.
Scenario 'meetkunde-schaal': Scale at a higher level: photographs a question.
Scenario 'meetkunde-spiekbrief': Opens the Meetkunde cheat sheet and photographs it.

functions.name: verhaal
functions.docstring: De tekst in het kader 'Het verhaal' als één regel.
functions.explanation: The story text of a word problem, read from the framed lines of the screen as one line.

functions.name: getal
functions.explanation: Parses a Dutch decimal string ('3,50') to a float.

functions.name: bedrag
functions.explanation: Formats a number as euros with a comma ('3,50').

functions.name: wisselgeld_vraag
functions.docstring: Vrij oefenen op Normaal tot er een wisselgeld-vraagstuk zonder overbodig gegeven staat: (a, p, b).
functions.explanation: Free-practices word problems until a change-giving problem without extra givens appears and returns (count, unit price, amount paid); raises RuntimeError after 300 tries.

Scenario 'vraagstukken-stappen': Word problem in four steps: photographs the start, step 1 (givens marked, what is asked), steps 2-3 (plan and klad checked per line), three tips with F1, and the worked solution after checking. Uses wisselgeld_vraag to find a suitable problem and computes the answers.
Scenario 'vraagstukken-tweede-kans': Gives the immediate answer to a problem that is an intermediate result: photographs the hint and the request to make a klad.
Scenario 'vraagstukken-tegels': Tiles problem answered with the perimeter instead of the area: photographs the hint.
Scenario 'vraagstukken-tijd': Time problem answered as if an hour had 100 minutes: photographs the klad hint, then clock times in the klad.
Scenario 'vraagstukken-speurneus': Speurneus (find the wrong line): photographs it.
Scenario 'vraagstukken-kan': 'Can that be right?' estimation question: photographs it.
Scenario 'vraagstukken-spiekbrief': Opens the Vraagstukken cheat sheet and photographs it.

functions.name: tafel_antwoord
functions.explanation: Solves the arithmetic question on screen (× : + −) and returns the answer as text.
Scenario 'snelrekenen': Speed arithmetic: photographs the menu, the 60 seconds / 20 sums choice, a running 20-sum round (answers computed with tafel_antwoord) and the result with the record.
Scenario 'herhalen': Photographs the Herhalen screen.
Scenario 'avatar': Avatar hub, shop, hats shelf, the buy question and a successful purchase.
Scenario 'avatar-kast': The wardrobe and the saved combinations.
Scenario 'spiekbrieven': Photographs the cheat-sheet menu.
Scenario 'opties': Photographs the old options screen.
Scenario 'zeg-het-ons': Writes a remark through 'Zeg het ons' and photographs the form and the thank-you.

functions.name: ouderdeel
functions.explanation: Navigates from the start screen to the parent password prompt.
Scenario 'ouder-menu': Parent area: photographs the password prompt and the parent menu (uses ouderdeel()).
Scenario 'ouder-rapport': Parent area: period choice, a report, the per-topic report, the calendar and an export.
Scenario 'ouder-kinderen': Parent area: the settings of one child.
Scenario 'ouder-punten': Parent area: the points log.
Scenario 'ouder-opmerkingen': Parent area: the remarks from 'Zeg het ons'.

functions.name: thema_beeld
functions.explanation: Starts a fraction-bar question, shades the needed pieces and photographs the screen in the started theme, for the colour themes.
Scenario 'start-standaard': Photographs the default theme through thema_beeld.
Scenario 'start-kleurenblind': Photographs the theme started with --kleurenblind.
Scenario 'start-blauw-geel': Photographs the theme started with --kleurenblind blauw-geel.
Scenario 'start-contrast': Photographs the theme started with --contrast.
Scenario 'start-geen-kleur': Photographs the theme started with --geen-kleur.
Scenario 'start-ascii': Photographs the theme started with --ascii.
Scenario 'start-ouder': Starts with --ouder (no child) and photographs the parent password screen directly.
